subject.title: feat(schema): add scalable catalog feed projections

question: Should ClawHub commit to these exported v1 query, change, tombstone, cursor, and reset semantics while the scalable-distribution RFC remains open?
rationale: Identity, pagination, sequence, reset, and removal semantics form a permanent public API contract and cannot be safely selected from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Finalize RFC first
options.body: Keep the draft open until the RFC is approved, then align the schemas and repository specification with the accepted contract.

options.title: Approve this v1 contract
options.body: Explicitly accept these exported names and semantics as the compatibility baseline for later storage, transport, signing, and consumer slices.

options.title: Keep types internal
options.body: Avoid exporting a v1 wire contract until an end-to-end prototype proves its producer and consumer behavior.

recommendation.title: Finalize RFC first
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until the RFC is approved, then align the schemas and repository specification with the accepted contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a permanent cross-project product and API direction decision rather than an isolated implementation repair.
